turns.message: What's the status of shipment SHP-2026-0002?
turns.answer:
Shipment SHP-2026-0002 was delayed but has now been successfully rerouted to an alternate route.

*   The initial delay was 72 hours, with a projected store availability delay of 126 hours.
*   The cause was a disruption on route RTE-105 (I-16 closure), which would have added 6 hours to transit time.
*   The shipment has been rerouted to RTE-111, which has a 3-day transit time.
*   This rerouting cost $3,330 and prevents the additional 6-hour delay from the RTE-105 disruption.
*   One order (ORD-2026-00003) for store STR-123 was affected.
*   An incident record has been created to document the delay and the at-risk supplier (SUP-005).
